text: {"1058":{"about":["rustc_lint"],"refers":[],"why":"Early lint passes in rustc_lint implement purely syntactic lint checks."},"1059":{"about":["rustc_lint"],"refers":["rustc_middle"],"why":"rustc_lint implements late lint passes, which inspect HIR defined in rustc_middle."},"1060":{"about":["rustc_lint"],"refers":[],"why":"Late lint execution in rustc_lint occurs after type analysis and can use type information."},"1061":{"about":["rustc_lint"],"refers":[],"why":"The distribution of lints between early and late passes is a responsibility of the lint framework."},"1062":{"about":["rustc_mir_transform"],"refers":["rustc_middle"],"why":"MIR-based lint execution is implemented by rustc_mir_transform over MIR data structures defined in rustc_middle."}}
